fact_text: Between 2023 and 2025 Pakistan's rupee stabilised, inflation eased and the policy rate fell, according to the presenter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: Demand for essentials holds up in a weak economy, while consumers cut non-essential spending when prices rise, and share prices follow these shifts in sales and profit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: Share prices rose once sales and profits recovered after stability returned, and the presenter argued the rally rested on fundamentals rather than speculation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: Engro Polymer (EPCL) has three main verticals: PVC for pipes, fittings and construction, caustic soda for textiles, detergents and soaps, and hydrogen peroxide.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: EPCL added a hydrogen peroxide plant, and textile mills use hydrogen peroxide as a bleaching agent.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: EPCL's captive gas rate for its power plant and process gas rose from PKR 3,000 to PKR 3,500 per MMBtu in January 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: EPCL's process gas rate rose 7% in July 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The PVC-ethylene core delta, the price spread that sets the sector margin, was about USD 275 per tonne in the June 2025 quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The PVC-ethylene core delta was about USD 300 per tonne in the March 2025 quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The PVC-ethylene core delta was about USD 350 per tonne in the June 2024 quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The spread narrowed steadily from 2022 onwards because ethylene costs, tied to oil prices, rose while PVC demand fell in the region, the US and China, squeezing EPCL's margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: EPCL's margin stood at about 0.8% as of 8 Aug 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The analyst expected EPCL's margin to reach double digits by the December 2025 or March 2026 quarter, which would shrink the company's overall loss.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: Global PVC demand was expected to improve, and local PVC demand was expected to recover by the December 2025 quarter, lifting PVC sales.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: Oil prices were expected to stay low and stable for about six months from Aug 2025, keeping ethylene prices steady, though the analyst said oil shocks cannot be predicted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: Cement dispatches rose about 30% year on year in July 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The analyst said the construction recovery shown by cement dispatches was expected to lift PVC sales, since PVC goes into pipes and fittings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What Drives Stock Prices And How You Can Learn to Identify It | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-08-08)

fact_text: The analyst said EPCL's share price fell because production costs rose sharply during 2023 to 2025, pushing the company into losses.
